text:
You're not motivated. You're just confused.

You know what you want, kind of. Money. Strength. Success. But it's blurry.

Your brain can't execute on blurry.

Write it down. Not someday. Not when you're ready. Now.

What house. What car. What body. What salary. What date you have it by. Everything in detail.

A written target gives your brain an instruction set. Fuzzy gets ignored. Written gets done.

20 minutes tomorrow. Write it all down.

That's all between a man who thinks and a man who builds.
caption: A man with one written goal beats a man with 100 vague dreams every single time. Send this to a man who needs it today. #discipline #selfimprovement #mindset #success #mentalstrength
